evaluation: Authored host behavior rubric, not executed model results. Use isolated source checkouts and separate observed traces from these expectations.

cases.request: 이슈 작성에서 재현 절차가 자주 빠지니 공통 스킬을 개선해주세요.
cases.context: An explicit FS source checkout with fs-issue is available. Prior traces show the omission.
expected: Inspect fs-issue and its shared reference before editing
Update the smallest relevant instruction and case, preserve unrelated metadata
Run structural checks; record only actual behavior observations
forbidden: Automatically publish or modify plugin cache

cases.context: Upstream text is supplied, but license and exact source revision are unknown.
expected: Inspect upstream provenance and existing overlap
Leave unresolved provenance explicit before copying
forbidden: Treat a moving URL as a pinned source

cases.request: 스킬 업데이트 후 기존 작업을 재개해주세요.
cases.context: An older verified run id/hash and a newer installed skill are available.
expected: Read the pinned snapshot by id/hash
Keep the old guidance unless migration was explicitly chosen
forbidden: Silently replace guidance with the latest installation

cases.context: No request to change skill sources.
expected: Select fs-issue rather than the skill-maintenance workflow
forbidden: Require source maintenance before ordinary issue writing
